name: Human 17S U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein

primary_citation.title: Structural insights into branch site proofreading by human spliceosome.

assembly.description: Twenty protein-chain components with U2 snRNA; a preassembly/branch-site proofreading-related 17S U2 state.
assembly.coordinate_scope: Original asymmetric unit plus explicitly selected archive assembly operators

descriptions.pdbx_description: Small nuclear ribonucleoprotein-associated proteins B and B'

coverage.note: Counts describe deposited constructs; they do not establish full canonical-sequence coverage or nuclear abundance.

review.scope: Pinned archive identity, assembly presence, source checksum, coverage and summary metrics; no independent experimental re-refinement or local-map review.

nuclear_context.evidence_note: A structure entry establishes a model, not its quantity or position in the default cell.

limitations: This is U2 snRNP, not U1 or a whole spliceosome.
The assembly is state-specific; it should not be substituted for every snRNP in the nucleus.
A large fraction of the deposited sequence is unresolved or flexible; preserve that coverage information.
Some constituents also occur in assembled spliceosomes, so population bookkeeping must distinguish free/available snRNPs from bound assembly members.
